messages:
elena (Product): Quick design review — noticed a few inconsistencies between the Console help panel and the public docs. Nothing urgent but worth a small pass: terminology, cross-linking targets, and a keyboard nav/a11y nit. sam (Design): saw that too this morning :eyes:. can you list the exact mismatches? elena (Product): sure — main ones: we use 'model version' in the docs but the Console UI says 'model variant' in the dropdown and the help panel. Also the help panel links to /models which is a landing page, not the specific model details. users should land on the model's version table. mike (Docs): ack. our docs canonical term is 'model version' (we call out variants in the model onboarding page only). happy to flip Console copy if that's the consensus. lisa (Eng): quick note on deep links: we can accept a hash + query to open the version tab. e.g. `/console/models/:id#versions` or `/docs/models/:id?tab=versions` depending on where we route. pradeep (Frontend): implementation detail — the help panel currently renders links with target="_blank" via our markdown renderer. if we change links to deep anchors, we should ensure they open in a new tab and also send an event to analytics (help_panel.link_click). zoe (QA): accessibility nit: when the help panel opens and focus moves into it, focus isn't trapped. keyboard users can tab behind the overlay. We should ensure focus trap and `esc` closes the panel. Also aria-labels on the link list are missing. :a11y: help-panel-bot: Heads-up: there is an open help-panel PR in staging that touches link rendering — https://staging.redwood-inference.com/changes/1234 sam (Design): proposal: 1) update UI copy from 'variant' -> 'version' in dropdown and help; 2) change help links to point to docs deep anchors (open in new tab); 3) add a small inline callout when a docs link opens: "Opening docs in a new tab" to avoid context loss. mockup:```html
  • View model version history
    • ``` mike (Docs): fine by me. I'll add a short alias blurb in the docs page: "model versions (sometimes referred to as variants in older UI)" for a week until rollout. will open a docs PR. pradeep (Frontend): for analytics/eventing: we will emit `{ event: 'help_panel.link_click', href, source: 'console_help_panel' }` (pseudocode). also will ensure the markdown renderer marks external links with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. lisa (Eng): attention: if we change the link target to a docs site path we need to whitelist the domain in the iframe/content policy used by the Console. will check with infra. zoe (QA): test plan notes: keyboard nav, focus trap, screenreader announcement when panel opens (use `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`), verify link opens new tab and is reachable to SR. I'll add regression tests. elena (Product): next steps (quick): - mike: docs PR to add alias blurb and deep-anchor targets (assign to mike). - pradeep + sam: small Console PR to swap copy + update markdown link template + analytics. - lisa: confirm domain whitelist and content-policy changes if any. - zoe: add QA checklist. If someone can post PR links here when ready that'd be great. I created a tracker card: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/CON-4829-console-help-docs-handshake mike (Docs): opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 — short copy change + alias note. pradeep (Frontend): opened draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/792 — copy + link template changes, still wiring analytics. elena (Product): awesome, thanks. once frontend and docs PRs are merged we'll do a short rollout and remove the alias blurb after a week. closing loop after QA sign-off. :thumbsup:
